title: otto_product_classification round input
description: Evaluation shape for one round. The test set is FIXED and identical in every round (it is a private, sha256-pinned R2 object mounted into the referee), so nothing here selects data and nothing derives from the platform SEED. These are transport knobs only: neither can change the score of a valid submission. Deliberately excluded: clip_eps (part of the metric's definition — changing it is a spec version bump, not a round input), any scored-subset fraction (its only effect would be to ADD variance to a competition that currently has exactly zero, reopening seed-fishing for no benefit), row count / split parameters (the ground truth's identity, pinned by sha256).

batch_size.description: Test ids per /act call. Batches are contiguous slices of the ascending test id order — no sampling, no shuffle, no seed. A batch_size at or above the test-set size degenerates to a single call.

deadline_ms.description: Per-/act deadline, enforced by the referee's HTTP client as deadline_ms/1000 + 1 s.
